main.description: Declares that a role exists. The record key is the role id.

default.description: Granted to whoever joins without being given roles: by requestJoin, or by admitMember when it names none. With no role marked so, a newcomer gets member.

bot.description: People with this role are bots: accounts that act on their own, not a person. A member is a bot if any of their roles says so.
